title: These Sony Headphones Are Half Off Right Now
author: Boutayna Chokrane
text: All products featured on WIRED are independently selected by our editors. However, we may receive compensation from retailers and/or from purchases of products through these links. Learn more.Sony is one of the most reliable electronics brands we’ve tested, and its track record extends across a range of categories. That's why when any of its products go on sale, we take notice. Right now, a few of Sony's headphones, including the premium Sony WH-1000XM5, are steeply discounted, including some of the lowest prices I've seen.For more Sony recommendations, check out our guides to the Best Wireless Headphones, Best Noise-Canceling Headphones, Best Soundbars, and Best OLED TVs.Love WIRED? Add us as a preferred source on Google to see more of us.Sony WH-1000XM5 for $198 ($202 Off)Courtesy of SonyCourtesy of SonySonyWH-1000XM5$400 $198 (51% off) Amazon$398 $198 (50% off) B&H Photo$400 $198 (51% off) SonyThese aren't the latest premium Sony headphones (that would be the Sony WH-1000XM6), but the Sony WH-1000XM5 are still some of the best wireless headphones you can buy. At 50 percent off, this is the lowest price I've seen on these headphones, making them an absolute steal. I wouldn’t wait to snag a pair.Trending NowWhy a Cheaper iPhone Is Better For YouAside from the minimal Sony branding, these headphones have a sleek, understated design, with pleather-covered memory foam on the ear cups and inside of the headband. At 250 grams, they’re lightweight and comfortable enough for lengthy listening sessions, though the pleather can get a little sweaty around the ears. The spacious soundstage works well across genres, delivering deep bass, crisp highs, and plenty of detail. Reviewer Simon Lucas also praises the excellent noise cancellation, solid companion app, and up to 30 hours of battery life with ANC turned on.More Sony DealsIf the WH-1000XM5s are out of your price range, I’ve spotted a few other Sony headphones deals worth considering.Courtesy of SonySonyWH-CH520$70 $38 (46% off) Amazon$68 $38 (44% off) Walmart$70 $38 (46% off) SonyCourtesy of SonyCourtesy of SonySonyWH-CH720N$180 $98 (46% off) Amazon$180 $98 (46% off) Walmart$180 $98 (46% off) SonyMost PopularDealsThe Best 15 Labor Day Deals on Amazon Right NowBy Matthew KorfhageGearThe Cybercab Is Almost Here. The WH-CH720N headphones can't match the quality of the premium 1000 series (and they don't come with a case), but their sound quality and noise cancellation are still excellent at full price, let alone 47 percent off.
